updates.closure_rationale: Actual ow_flawed_write uses defined unsigned wrap and masked accesses within one real16-cell array. The selected tenant0 request modifies tenant1 indices12..15 and tenant0 indices0..3; the repaired original API preserves every cell. Logical authority failure is separate from C out-of-bounds access, sanitizer reporting, arbitrary code execution and privilege escalation. Trusted parent selection, live typed storage and external serialization are explicit premises rather than guarantees enforced by ISO C. OafRoot/OafView separate trusted authority from untrusted OafRequest numeric fields. A subtraction proof bounds parent and request intervals before a translation-unit-private Validated descriptor reaches the indexing core. Read stages its output, write changes only the admitted interval, and native/wire paths share the same validator. Syntactic validity, freshness and permission are distinct checks with specified status precedence. Same-process forged structs remain a counterexample to an unforgeable-capability claim. Six actual C17 compiler profiles execute six anchors, eight compiled semantic controls and six compiling-stub rejections. The independent mathematical set-membership oracle checks40320combinations, including all rights, both trusted tenants, malformed third tenant, epochs0/1/2/MAX and extreme extents. Separate tests enumerate363original ordinary extent cases, exact16-byte big-endian encoding, every truncated length, unknown version/rights/reserved data, overlap-safe decode, unchanged refusal, empty one-past and epoch retirement. Six separately compiled receivers execute66Python-generated foreign requests each. Exact object imports, code/stack measurements and seven equivalent workload samples retain source/toolchain pins; no whole-process or physical guarantee follows. The required delayed change is implemented: nested read-only subviews cannot gain write rights or expand extent. Every decoded foreign request is revalidated against a server-selected trusted parent; arbitrary epoch/rights/tenant fields are not a credential. Revocation rejects both retained old views and old bytes under a fresh view; UINT32_MAX retires without wrapping. Native and serialized admission are compared through actual Python-to-C byte streams. An additional analysis variant changes who selects the parent and requires the learner to identify the missing authentication premise; independent learner assessment remains unobserved. Bounded author support only.
